{{Short description|German business executive}}
[[File:Dr. rer. nat. Volkmar Denner.jpg|thumb|Volkmar Denner 2017]]
'''Dr. Volkmar Denner''' (born 30 November 1956 in [[Uhingen]]) is a German business executive who was the [[CEO]] of [[Robert Bosch GmbH]] from 2012 July <ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/person/16198297|title=Volkmar Denner Profile|last=|first=|date=|website=[[Bloomberg News]]|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref> to 2021 December.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bosch-presse.de/pressportal/de/de/dr-ing-stefan-hartung-43341.html|title=Dr.-Ing. Stefan Hartung|last=|first=|date=|website=|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref>

==Education==
Denner graduated with a [[doctorate]] in [[physics]] from the [[University of Stuttgart]].<ref>{{Cite book|last1=Franz|first1=Christoph|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=HwXVDgAAQBAJ&q=Denner+graduated+with+a+doctorate+in+physics+from+the+University+of+Stuttgart.&pg=PR8|title=Evolving Business Models: How CEOs Transform Traditional Companies|last2=Bieger|first2=Thomas|last3=Herrmann|first3=Andreas|date=2017-05-09|publisher=Springer|isbn=978-3-319-48938-4|language=en}}</ref>

==Career==
Denner has spent his whole career with Bosch.<ref>http://www.bosch.com/en/com/bosch_group/board_management/dr_rer_nat_volkmar_denner/volkmar-denner.html Bosch</ref> In 2012, when he was head of research and engineering, beat out auto parts chief [[Bernd Bohr]] to replace incumbent [[Franz Fehrenbach]] in a move that made him only the seventh CEO since Bosch was founded in 1886.<ref>Hendrik Sackmann and Christiaan Hetzner (April 26, 2012), [https://www.reuters.com/article/bosch/corrected-raw-material-costs-hamper-bosch-margin-goal-in-12-idUSF9E7J100Z20120426 Raw material costs hamper Bosch margin goal in '12] ''[[Reuters]]''.</ref>

During the [[Hannover Messe]] in April 2016, Denner was among the 15 German CEOs who were invited to a private dinner with [[President of the United States of America|President]] [[Barack Obama]].<ref>Hans von der Burchard (April 25, 2016), [http://www.politico.eu/article/politico-pros-morning-trade-merkel-we-should-hurry-up-with-ttip-obama-defends-isds/ POLITICO Pro’s Morning Trade: Breaking bread with the president] ''[[Politico Europe]]''.</ref>

==Other activities==
* Baden-Badener Unternehmer-Gespräche (BBUG), Member of the Board<ref>[https://www.bbug.de/de/ueber-uns/der-verein.php Board] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180109181920/https://www.bbug.de/de/ueber-uns/der-verein.php |date=2018-01-09 }} Baden-Badener Unternehmer-Gespräche (BBUG).</ref>
* Deutscher Zukunftspreis, Member of the Board of Trustees<ref>[http://www.deutscher-zukunftspreis.de/en/the-prize/board-trustees Board of Trustees] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180420135902/http://www.deutscher-zukunftspreis.de/en/the-prize/board-trustees |date=2018-04-20 }} Deutscher Zukunftspreis.</ref>
* [[Verband der Automobilindustrie|German Association of the Automotive Industry]] (VDA), Member of the Managing Board<ref>[https://www.vda.de/en/association/organization/managing-board-presiding-board Managing Board & Presiding Board] [[Verband der Automobilindustrie|German Association of the Automotive Industry]] (VDA).</ref>
